text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... That was a great race.
Honestly, anyone could have won it.
choice_data_list: I took first place among them.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Well, naturally!
That's just who I am!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Still, I need more results under my belt. After all, my goal is the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll leave the next preparations to you.
Make sure to prepare the grandest stage for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I've gotta go show everyone
what makes me the "No. 1 Umamusume"♪

And through it all, Daiwa Scarlet continued
to smile for the wildly cheering crowd.
It happened on the way back—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you back in Japan way too soon?
Did you run home with your tail between your legs after failing to get results?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. I still plan to go overseas
sometime this year, but before that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I was thinking it's time we settled things once and for all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Settled.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ever since the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, it's been eating at me. I want to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Are you really okay with just sitting back after being shown running that cool?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha, what's that about?
You came all the way back just for that?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fine, I'll take that bait.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I've been thinking about it ever since the Derby, too.
About how I want to beat you."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, you've never let go of that number one spot, and I swore I'd surpass you no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, what's that about?
You copying me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's not true. You were the one copying me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —The Tenno Sho (Autumn). That's where we'll settle this.

The Tenno Sho (Autumn). Among the many GⅠ races,
it is highly prestigious and considered one of the
greatest honors for a Senior-tier Umamusume.
choice_data_list: If you win, you'll definitely get plenty of attention.
If you win, you'll definitely get plenty of attention, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a dream opportunity
for us, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll enter the race.
And I'm gonna blow right past you there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us settle this.
Who is superior. Who is "Number One."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I definitely won't lose.
...Especially not to you.

And the stage for their clash has been set.
All that remains is to prepare for the decisive battle...!
